strings: Details related to any statement or action, in any form prescribed or accepted by the Government Agency, giving information or particulars required by the Governmental Agency.
Code specifying the function of a document.

In the WCO Data Model the API Document identifier is mapped to Message function, coded instead of using the Document reference number.

The combination of Document Name Code and Document Identifier Code will result in:
745  CP  Change Passenger Data
745  XR  Cancel Reservation
745  RP  Reduction in Party 
266  CL  Flight Close (only) Flight Close w/ identified Passengers not on-board 
266  CLOB  Flight Close w/ identified Passengers on-board
266  XF  Cancel Flight
266  CF  Change Flight/Itinerary
250  CL  Crew Flight Close (only)
250  CLNB Crew Flight Close w/ identified Crew not on-board 
250  CLOB  Crew Flight Close w/ identified Crew on-board
Identification of a specific information exchange.
Date and time the document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.
Code specifying the name of a document.

*Note: A gate pass is an authorization for a non-travelling person to access the sterile area of airports for the purpose of accompanying a ticketed traveller. (Presently used only in the United States.)

Details related to the means of transport crossing the border of the Customs territory.
Crossing the border transport means name
Name to identify the means of transport used for the carriage of the goods in crossing the border.
Transport means crossing the border identifier
Identification of the means of transport used in crossing the border.

Sea: ITU Standard or Lloyd's number
Air: IATA aircraft ID
Road: national license plate
Rail: locomotive number
Type of identification of means of transport crossing the border code
Code specifying type of identifier of the means of transport used for the carriage of the goods in crossing the border.
Type of means of transport crossing the border code
Code specifying type of means of transport used for the carriage of the goods in crossing the border.
Nationality of means of transport crossing the border code
Code specifying nationality of the active means of transport used for the carriage of the goods in crossing the border.
First port of arrival in customs territory date/time
Date and time of arrival (actual or scheduled) of the means of transport at the first port (e.g. seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station).
Measure of the overall size of a ship determined in accordance with the provisions of the international convention on tonnage measurement of ships, 1969.
Length of single vehicle expressed in meters.
Measure of the useful capacity of a ship determined in accordance with the provisions of international convention on tonnage measurements of ships, 1969.
Identification of the stay of a means of transport in a port or airport or other place of service.
Weight in metric tons of cargo, ship's fuel, passengers and crew carried by a ship when loaded to its maximum summer load line.
Description of the cargo in general terms only.
Code specifying the International Safe Carriage of Packaged Irradiated Nuclear Fuel, Plutonium and High-Level Radioactive Wastes on Board Ships, as assigned to a ship carrying INF cargo.
Indicator whether the vessel has a dangerous and/or polluting goods (DPG) list on board.
Maximum distance from side to side of the means of transport.
Depth of water from the surface of water to the bottom of the vessel measured at the draft mark of the stern.
Depth of water from the surface of water to the bottom of the vessel measured at the draft mark of the bow.
Maneuvering speed of the means of transport at the pilot station location or port area entrance.
Details related to the conveyance facilities at the arrival location.
Identification of a terminal, warehouse or yard where a means of transport arrives.
Details related to the bunkers onboard a vessel.
Number indicating the position in a sequence.
Details related to the properties of the goods.
Details related to the non-commercial categorization of a commodity by a standard-setting organization.
Identification of the non-commercial categorization of a commodity by a standard-setting organization.
Code specifying the commodity classification  (e.g. Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS), Export Control Classification Code (ECCC), UNDG Code list, International Code of Zoological Nomenc).
Measure of the flashpoint temperature of dangerous goods.
Details related to goods weight, quantities, and amounts.
Weight of the goods themselves without any packing.
Details related to the location of the goods.
Name of the location where goods are located.
Details related to the purpose of the conveyance call.
Code specifying the purpose of the conveyance call.
Code specifying  the subject of the characteristic.
Code specifying the form of a characteristic value.
UN/EDIFACT code list 7111 / User code list
Details related to the itinerary of the means of transport.

To identify the arrival and departure airports relating to the specified flight. 
Airport codes are published in the IATA Airline Coding Directory
Identification of a single port of call or other location of the itinerary of a means of transport.
Date and time of arrival at itinerary port of the means of transport.

The default format is ?YYMMDD? (n6) ?130628? 
Other format is ?YYMMDDHHMM? (n10).
?1306281205'
Date and time of departure at itinerary port of the means of transport.
Code specifying the type of the itinerary location.
Name of the location of the terminal, warehouse or yard where a means of transport arrives.
Indicator of the arrival of vessels at anchorage location or departure of vessels from anchorage location.
Details related to the operator of a mode of transport (e.g. pilot, driver, master of vessel).
Name of the the operator of a mode of transport (e.g. pilot, driver, master of vessel).
Identification of the operator of a mode of transport (e.g. pilot, driver, master of vessel).
Details related to the person on board of a transport means.
DMR needed for Communication number(s) of the passenger?
Code specifying  if a person is a transit passenger.
Details related to the disembarkation location.
Identification of a port or location of disembarkation.
DMR needed for weight of the baggage

Description of personal belongings in the possession of individual crew members or passengers which according to regulations in force at the location of arrival of a means of transport are dutiable or subject to prohibitions or restrictions.

Quantity specifying the number of  personal belongings in the possession of individual crew members or passengers which according to regulations in force at the place of arrival of a means of transport are dutiable or subject to prohibitions or restrictions.
Details related to the embarkation location.
Identification of a port or location of embarkation.
Date and time of embarkation of a person on board.
Family name of a person as mentioned in an official document.
Given name of a person as mentioned in an official document.
Job title or the rank of a person.
Code specifying the nationality of a person.
Date and time an individual was born.
Name of the location where a person is or was born.
Code specifying the gender of a person.
Code specifying the status of a person on board.
DMR needed for Person on board type, code with code list 3035
Details related to the travel document (e.g. passport).
Identification of the travel document by number.
Travel document issuing country or political entity
Country or political entity issuing the travel document.
Code specifying the name of a travel document.
Details related to the item in the ship's stores.
Quantity specifying the goods in the unit as required by customs for tariff, statistical, fiscal purposes or as indicated in "type".
Details related to operations taking place between ships whether at sea, in inshore waters or within harbor limits while not berthed.
Date and time of the start of a ship-to-ship activity period.
Date and time of the end of a ship-to-ship activity period.
Details related to the location where the ship to ship activity takes place.
Name of the location where the ship-to-ship activity takes place.
Identification of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other place at which a ship to ship activity takes place.
Details related to coordinates from Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) where goods are available.
Angular distance of a place north or south of the Earth's equator.
Angular distance of a place east or west of the standard (Greenwich) meridian.
Details related to the total number of persons (e.g. passengers, crew).
Code specifying the type of person (Crew, Passenger, Stowaway, etc.).
Quantity specifying the total number of persons (passengers and crew, including the captain/master) on board of a means of transport.
Details related to transport equipment used for the consignment.
Code specifying the characteristics (e.g. size and type of a piece of transport equipment).
ISO, IATA, EDIFACT (8053 or 8155) OR User code list
Code specifying how full a piece of transport equipment is.
Identification of the equipment (e.g. unit load device by marks, letters, and/or numbers).
Details related to the location on board a means of transport where specified goods or transport equipment has been or are to be stowed.
Identification of the equipment location on the conveyance.
UN/LOCODE + User codes OR BayRowTier OR User codes (based on IMO FAL Convention)
Details related to the operator of a means of transport (e.g. the captain of a vessel).
Name of the registered operator of the means of transport.
Identification of the registered operator of the means of transport.
Details related to waste and cargo residues which are onboard the vessel and which will be either (partly) delivered or will (partly) remain on board during a port call.
Description of the nature of a goods item sufficient to identify it for cross-border regulatory purposes such as customs, phytosanitary, statistical or transport.
Code specifying the purpose of the measurement.
Measure of the gross volume of the item, excluding unoccupied volume of the packaging.
Details related to the location at which the goods (i.e., consignment) are unloaded from the active means of transport having been used for their carriage.
Identification of a seaport, airport, freight terminal, rail station or other location at which goods are unloaded from the means of transport having been used for their carriage.
Details related to the party undertaking or arranging transport of goods between named points.
Name of the party providing the transport of goods between named points.
Identification of a party providing the transport of goods between named points.

Name of the company security officer as described in IMO Circular MSC 1130.
Details related to the transport between a consignor and a consignee as specified in the transport contract document.
Code specifying split consignment for each load assigned by a carrier.

Name of the party to which goods are consigned.
Identification of a party to which goods are consigned.

UN/EDIFACT code list 4405 OR User code list

Identification of the location in country or country from which the goods were initially despatched to the importing country.
Weight of goods including packing but excluding carrier's equipment.

Directions for handling a consignment and/or delivery directions for a shipment.
Code specifying the directions for handling a shipment and/or delivery for a shipment.
Marks and or numbers on a transport unit or package.
Quantity specifying the number of individual items packaged in such a way that they cannot be divided without first undoing the packing.
Code specifying the type of package of an item.
Details related to the party which, by contract with a carrier, consigns or sends goods with the carrier, or has them conveyed by him.
Name of the party consigning goods as stipulated in the transport contract by the party ordering transport.
Identification of  the party consigning goods as stipulated in the transport contract by the party ordering the transport.
Details related to freight payment, rate quantity, type, and amount.

Code specifying the payment method for transport charges.

Identification of the document evidencing a transport contract by reference number.
Code specifying the type of a document evidencing a transport contract .
Details related to the seal affixed to a piece of transport equipment, used to secure an object and protect from unauthorized entry or tampering.
Identification of a seal affixed to a piece of transport equipment by number.
Details related to the party who makes a declaration to an official body or - where legally permitted - in whose name, or on whose behalf, a declaration to an official body is made.
